title: Netflix Is Making a Live-Action PUBG Series With Donald Glover
content:
Netflix is developing a live-action series based on PUBG: Battlegrounds, and Donald Glover is attached to write, direct, executive produce and star. Netflix and Krafton, the South Korean company that owns the game, announced the project on 29 October, with TheWrap among the first to carry it. His brother Stephen Glover, a writer on Atlanta, will write and executive produce, Gematsu reported .

Beyond those names, the Netflix PUBG series has no plot, setting, release window or cast yet. What’s on Netflix reports that the scripts haven’t been written, and its own estimate is that the show won’t reach the service before 2028.

Netflix’s announcement, as quoted by Gizmodo, called PUBG “the best-selling game from Krafton that globally popularized the battle royale genre” and “a global cultural icon with seven Guinness World Records”. Krafton said the series is part of a push to “expand the franchise beyond gaming into original entertainment content”.

Most game adaptations that have worked on screen started with people. HBO’s The Last of Us had Joel and Ellie. Arcane, which won the Emmy for outstanding animated program in 2022, had Vi and Jinx. PUBG has nobody. It drops up to 100 players onto an island, they scavenge for weapons while a shrinking circle forces them together, and the last player or squad alive wins. Every character in the show will have to be invented.

The premise isn’t new either. PUBG grew out of the battle royale mods Brendan Greene made for Arma, and the genre takes its name from the 2000 Japanese film Battle Royale. Strangers fighting to be the last one standing has been on screen many times since, The Hunger Games included, so a straight retelling would land in crowded territory. Prime Video’s Fallout is a better model: it kept the world and the tone of the games and wrote new characters into them.

Nothing in Glover’s record suggests a straight action show. Atlanta, the FX series he created, won him two Emmys in 2017, for lead actor in a comedy and for directing a comedy, according to the Television Academy , which lists 14 nominations for him in total. That year Atlanta also won the Golden Globe for best musical or comedy series, and Glover won the Globe for best actor. The show often left its main characters behind for standalone episodes, especially in its third season, and it rarely did what viewers expected.

title: Overwatch ranks in order (2026): Full rank list and SR explained
content:
Overwatch has 10 competitive ranks starting at Bronze and ending with Top 500 Challenger. Here are all Overwatch ranks in order plus their SR ranges and how the ranked system works in 2026.

The competitive ranks in Overwatch show where you stand on the Competitive Play ladder. Players progress through the Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Emerald, Diamond, Master, Grandmaster, and Champion tiers, and only the best of best are in the Top 500 Challenger rank.

Each Overwatch rank has five divisions going from 5 to 1. Division 5 is the lowest within a rank while Division 1 is the highest. For example, Platinum 5 is the lowest Platinum rank while Platinum 1 is the highest.

Winning Competitive matches increases your rank progress while losing can decrease it. Top 500 Challenger works differently and uses leaderboard placement and Challenger Score instead of the standard division system.

In Overwatch, your rank is determined by your Hero Skill Rating (HSR). This is more commonly known as just “SR” by players.

Winning Competitive matches increases your SR and rank progress while losing can decrease it. Top 500 Challenger uses Challenger Score and leaderboard placement instead of the standard SR divisions.

title: Nemiga’s win over FUT likely costs Astralis cmtry at the Major
content:
Under Valve’s rule for players listed on two Major rosters, Nemiga’s quarter-final win over FUT should keep cmtry on FUT’s list and out of Astralis’ lineup in Singapore, although none of the parties have confirmed it.

FUT Esports went out of PGL Masters Bucharest on Thursday morning, beaten 2-0 by Nemiga in the first quarter-final. The result matters as much in Barcelona as in Bucharest: it means SunPayus stays on four FUT matches, one short of the five that would have taken Mykyta “ cmtry ” Samolotov off FUT’s roster before Valve’s snapshot on 2 November.

FUT’s next match is against Spirit at BLAST Rivals on 11 November, nine days after the snapshot. Unless something changes in the registration, cmtry will still count as a FUT player when the Major invitations go out.

Valve explained the situation earlier this week in a reply that HLTV journalist Striker posted on X, and we went through it on Wednesday . If the same player appears on two invited rosters, the team with the higher VRS keeps him and the other team cannot take part. A player registered on one roster also cannot be registered as a coach or substitute for another.

FUT are above Astralis in the standings. Read together with Thursday’s result, the rule leaves Astralis without cmtry at the Major, not even as a substitute. Their lineup in Singapore should be the one that has played in Barcelona since Wednesday: jabbi , Staehr , phzy , ryu and siuhy , with NEO as coach.

James Banks was among the first to point this out after the quarter-final, writing on X that Astralis will play the Major with jabbi and not cmtry, and that SunPayus will likely play for FUT as a substitute but without a sticker.

content:
Two EMEA rosters changed hands in one evening, and both stories end in the same place: the Open Qualifiers for VCT EMEA Kickoff 2027.

NAVI have said goodbye to their entire 2026 Valorant roster, and within hours Aurora Gaming announced a lineup built around three of the region’s biggest free agents: Nikita “Derke” Sirmitev, Ričardas “Boo” Lukaševičius and Nikita “trexx” Cherednichenko.

NAVI thanked “all the players and staff who have been part of NAVI VALORANT throughout 2026” on 28 October. Gone are Emirhan “hiro” Kat, Uğur “Ruxic” Güç, Caide “chloric” Heaton, Abdullah “ExiT” Al-Twaijri, Clément “CyvOph” Millard and head coach Kyrylo “ANGE1” Karasov. chloric, ExiT and CyvOph had already been listed as inactive since September.

As the new VCT season approaches, we want to say a huge thank you to all the players and staff who have been part of NAVI VALORANT throughout 2026. We wish everyone the best of luck in their future journeys and hope to see them shine on the big stage again. 💛 pic.twitter.com/8FBaQcfIXA

The release follows NAVI’s announcement on 19 October that they had not been selected as a VCT partner for 2027. Instead of chasing a place with a rebuilt senior team, the organisation is putting its name on its academy side. NAVI Junior, with Vitalii “Javelin” Fedak, Herman “Kolosha” Skrypka, Waniss “Darxcioo” Mehl, Nikita “avey” Ivanovs, Wiktor “sizo” Bujak and coach Ivan “Johnta” Shevtsov, will represent NAVI in the EMEA Kickoff Europe Qualifier.

The 2026 season gave NAVI few reasons to hold on to the old core. hiro, Ruxic and ANGE1 were kept from 2025, with ANGE1 moving from in-game leader to head coach. NAVI finished in the top eight at Kickoff, then replaced Andrey “Shao” Kiprsky and Volkan “sociablEE” Yonal with chloric as IGL and ExiT as duelist. Visa problems delayed ExiT, so Berkcan “ComeBack” Şentürk stood in for Stage 1, where NAVI went 2-3 in the group stage and missed the playoffs. Dawid “Filu” Czarnecki made way for CyvOph before Stage 2, which ended the same way: 2-3 in the group, then out in the play-ins against Team Heretics.

title: NAVI and BetBoom get quick rematches in the Bucharest quarter-finals
content:
Two of Thursday’s quarter-finals at PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 replay series from the last fortnight, and in both the team that lost has yet to find an answer to the other.

NAVI face Team Vitality at 12:00 CET , two days after a 2-0 defeat to the same opponent in the Swiss stage, and BetBoom Team close the day against FURIA at 18:00 CET , eleven days after losing the Thunderpick World Championship final to them 3-2. The 13-9 followed a 13-2 loss on their own Inferno pick, and it extended a pattern that ran through their group stage: across four maps against BetBoom and Vitality, NAVI won four of 34 rounds played after the switch.

They reached the playoffs anyway. A 2-1 win over Team Spirit in Wednesday’s last Swiss round knocked Spirit out and was NAVI’s first series win over them since IEM Katowice 2025. makazze and w0nderful had more than 100 kills between them in the series.

title: Valve introduces big head mutators in Counter-Strike 2 alongside silent reload adjustments and leaked LAR rifle files
content:
Valve released a new update for Counter-Strike 2 last night. While the official patch notes focus on adjustments to the silent reload mechanic and minor bug fixes, backend changes discovered by dataminers reveal new casual mode modifiers and files for an unreleased rifle.

The main gameplay modification in the official changelog addresses how players execute silent reloads. Valve added a setting that allows users to switch the silent reload input between hold and toggle. With the toggle option enabled, players can release the reload key once the silent reload animation begins. If a player needs to abort the quiet reload and transition back to a standard fast reload, tapping the reload key a second time will cancel the action.

Alongside the input adjustment, the update resolves an audio defect. Previously, the initial sound cue of a weapon reload would occasionally play for nearby players regardless of whether a silent reload was initiated. This inconsistency has now been patched.

In the miscellaneous section of the patch notes, Valve fixed a rendering issue on AMD graphics cards where liquid surfaces appeared completely black. The developers also corrected multiple user interface and audio bugs triggered when rewinding footage during demo playback.

Beyond the official documentation, inspections of the game files by community dataminers Thour and Gabe Follower exposed new weapon assets. According to Thour, files and an inventory icon for a weapon designated as the LAR were added to the client with this patch.

Gabe Follower noted that this weapon is a renamed version of the previously leaked M14. The current files indicate that the LAR functions like a Winchester rifle, utilizing a per-bullet reloading mechanic. However, the materials for the weapon are currently stored inside a folder labeled “do_not_ship”, indicating that the firearm is still in development and not ready for public release.

title: Worlds 2026 : T1 et Invictus Gaming en quarts, KOI et LYON en 2-2
content:
Les champions du monde en titre n’ont pas tremblé. Opposé à Movistar KOI, T1 a survolé son BO3 pour s’imposer 2-0, porté notamment par un Doran impérial sur la toplane. Le Coréen a terminé la première manche avec un impressionnant 6/0/6 sur Ambessa, avant de récidiver sur Gwen (4/0/7). Une démonstration de force qui permet à T1 de rejoindre Dplus KIA et Gen.G en quarts de finale, devenant ainsi la troisième équipe coréenne qualifiée. Faker continue également d’écrire l’histoire, avec une onzième qualification pour les quarts de finale des Worlds, un record absolu dans la compétition.

Pour KOI, en revanche, la situation devient préoccupante. Après avoir débuté le Swiss Stage par deux victoires, les Espagnols viennent d’enchaîner deux défaites face à Dplus KIA et T1. Désormais en 2-2, ils devront impérativement remporter leur prochain BO3 pour poursuivre l’aventure. Une dernière chance de rejoindre le top 8 mondial, après avoir échoué à faire tomber deux des favoris coréens.

On offre tout à T1 pic.twitter.com/kTYgqGInk5

Dans l’autre rencontre de la soirée, Invictus Gaming a dû batailler pour venir à bout de LYON (2-1). Les Chinois ont d’abord écrasé la première manche en seulement 25 minutes, avec un sévère 19-4 au tableau d’affichage. Rookie s’est particulièrement illustré sur Aurora (8/1/8), pendant qu’Inspired est complètement passé à côté de sa partie avec Nocturne (1/6/1). Le jungler polonais s’est toutefois repris dans la deuxième manche, cette fois sur Qiyana (4/1/5), bien épaulé par un Dhokla agressif sur Olaf (4/2/3). De quoi permettre à LYON d’égaliser et d’arracher une manche décisive.

Mais la manche décisive a rapidement tourné à la démonstration. Dépassé dès la draft, LYON n’a jamais réussi à contenir la botlane chinoise, où JiaQi et Meiko ont fait vivre un véritable enfer à leurs adversaires. Impérial sur Caitlyn (5/1/2), JiaQi a même conclu la rencontre sur un triple kill, scellant la victoire d’Invictus Gaming en seulement 24 minutes. Les Chinois deviennent ainsi les premiers représentants de la LPL à décrocher leur billet pour les quarts de finale de ces Worlds 2026. Une qualification particulière pour TheShy et Rookie, qui se retrouvent ensemble dans le top 8 mondial huit ans après leur sacre historique sous les couleurs d’IG en 2018.

Pour LYON, la désillusion est immense. Après avoir parfaitement lancé leur tournoi avec deux victoires consécutives, les Américains ont enchaîné deux revers face à Gen.G et Invictus Gaming. En 2-2, ils se retrouvent dos au mur comme Movistar KOI. Les deux formations occidentales devront impérativement remporter leur dernier BO3 du Swiss Stage pour espérer rejoindre les quarts de finale.

title: How to Register for BGMI Air Closed Beta Test: Form, Last Date and Video Rules
content:
If you have been waiting for a chance to play BGMI Air before everyone else, the BGMI Air closed beta is your shot. Krafton has opened registration through an audition, and getting in comes down to one short video. Tell them, in 15 to 60 seconds, why you should be among the first to play. Then fill in the official form before 11:59 PM on November 9, 2026.

There are a few catches, though. You need to be 18 or older. You will have to travel to Mumbai, Delhi or Kolkata on your own money. And if you get picked, you cannot tell a single friend about it until late November.

We opened the form and went through every section of it so you know exactly what you are signing up for before you hit record. Here is all of it, in plain words.

BGMI Air is the lighter version of Battlegrounds Mobile India. It was called BGMI Lite until October 15, when Krafton India renamed it after more than 10 million people pre-registered. It is built for phones that struggle with the full game, which is exactly why so many players are excited about it.

The closed beta is not something you download at home. It is an in-person playtest. Krafton will pick players and invite them to a session in Mumbai, Delhi or Kolkata, where they get to play the game before it launches.

So if you see a “BGMI Air beta APK” floating around WhatsApp groups or YouTube descriptions, please skip it. The audition form is the only way in.

title: Test Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 sur PS5 : un retour aux fondamentaux qui fait du bien
content:
Chaque année, la sortie d’un nouveau Call of Duty suscite son lot d’attentes, de débats et de comparaisons avec les épisodes précédents. La série a beau rester une référence du FPS grand public, elle n’a pas toujours réussi à renouveler sa formule sans perdre une partie de son identité. Entre les déplacements toujours plus spectaculaires, les approches parfois très éloignées du champ de bataille traditionnel et les propositions qui privilégient la surenchère, j’avais parfois eu l’impression que la franchise cherchait davantage à se réinventer qu’à perfectionner ce qu’elle savait déjà faire. Avec Modern Warfare 4, Infinity Ward semble avoir pris une direction différente : revenir à un cadre militaire contemporain, à des affrontements plus lisibles et à une action nerveuse, sans pour autant renoncer aux sensations qui ont fait le succès de la licence.

Dès mes premières parties, j’ai apprécié cette volonté de retrouver un équilibre entre efficacité arcade et crédibilité visuelle. Les soldats restent rapides, les fusillades conservent leur intensité et les affrontements peuvent basculer en quelques secondes, mais les mouvements paraissent un peu plus mesurés. Les armes ont du poids, les déplacements gagnent en cohérence et les différentes possibilités offertes sur le terrain enrichissent les combats sans transformer chaque rencontre en concours de figures acrobatiques. Le résultat n’a rien d’un simulateur militaire pur et dur, et ce n’est d’ailleurs pas ce que je lui demande. Modern Warfare 4 cherche plutôt à proposer un FPS accessible, réactif et spectaculaire, avec une identité militaire suffisamment affirmée pour se distinguer de certaines orientations plus exubérantes de la série.

Cette direction constitue à mes yeux l’une des grandes réussites de cet épisode. Le jeu ne bouleverse pas tout ce que l’on connaît de Call of Duty, mais il retravaille plusieurs éléments importants pour donner davantage de cohérence à l’ensemble. Surtout, il ne repose pas uniquement sur sa campagne pour convaincre : entre le solo, le multijoueur classique et DMZ, j’ai découvert trois expériences qui partagent les mêmes fondations tout en proposant des objectifs et des sensations suffisamment différents. Cette générosité donne à Modern Warfare 4 une vraie valeur sur la durée et explique en grande partie mon enthousiasme.

C’est par sa campagne que Modern Warfare 4 cherche d’abord à marquer les esprits, et je dois reconnaître qu’Infinity Ward a plutôt bien préparé son retour. L’aventure nous entraîne au cœur d’un conflit international impliquant notamment les deux Corées et la Russie, avec des opérations qui nous conduisent dans plusieurs grandes villes et zones de combat. De Séoul à New York, en passant par d’autres environnements urbains particulièrement soignés, le jeu multiplie les changements de décor et les situations pour éviter que l’histoire ne s’enferme dans une succession de fusillades interchangeables.

La campagne adopte surtout une approche narrative intéressante en alternant plusieurs points de vue. D’un côté, nous découvrons le conflit à travers des soldats sud-coréens, parfois encore novices, qui se retrouvent plongés dans une guerre dépassant largement leur expérience. De l’autre, Captain Price suit une trajectoire plus personnelle, guidée par une volonté de vengeance qui l’amène à remettre en question certains principes ayant longtemps défini le personnage. Cette opposition entre des combattants confrontés brutalement à la réalité du terrain et un opérateur chevronné engagé dans une affaire intime donne au récit une dimension plus humaine qu’une simple succession de missions héroïques.

J’ai particulièrement apprécié les séquences qui prennent le temps de montrer les conséquences du conflit sur les populations civiles. Modern Warfare 4 ne se contente pas d’aligner des explosions et des interventions spectaculaires : il cherche aussi à faire ressentir la violence d’une guerre qui ne touche pas uniquement les soldats présents sur le front. Certaines missions, notamment du côté nord-coréen, adoptent un ton plus sombre et mettent en scène des situations difficiles, qui contrastent efficacement avec les opérations plus classiques menées par des unités d’élite. Cette diversité de points de vue permet de renouveler l’approche du récit et donne parfois aux événements une intensité qui dépasse le simple plaisir de l’action.

title: RLCS : la Karmine Corp officialise les départs de Vatira, Atow et juicy
content:
La Karmine Corp repart de zéro, ou presque. Dans un message publié ce mardi sur ses réseaux sociaux, le club français a confirmé les départs d’Axel « Vatira » Touret, Tristan « Atow » Soyez et Charles « juicy » Sabiani, mettant fin à l’aventure d’un trio qui aura marqué la saison 2026 des RLCS. Ensemble, les trois joueurs avaient notamment remporté le Major de Paris face à Twisted Minds, avant de terminer dans le dernier carré des Championnats du monde. Un bilan prestigieux, mais insuffisant pour prolonger leur collaboration une saison supplémentaire.

Le départ le plus symbolique reste évidemment celui de Vatira, véritable visage de la Karmine Corp sur Rocket League depuis quatre ans. Atow quitte également le club après trois saisons, au cours desquelles il a remporté trois titres internationaux en LAN aux côtés de son compatriote, ainsi que l’Esports World Cup 2025. Les deux Français devraient désormais rejoindre Gentle Mates pour former un trio exceptionnel avec Alexis « zen » Bernier. De son côté, juicy, arrivé il y a seulement un an, est attendu chez Geekay Esports aux côtés de Seikoo et mtzr.

Si les trois joueurs quittent officiellement le navire, la Karmine Corp ne compte pas pour autant revoir ses ambitions à la baisse. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Evan « M0nkey M00n » Rogez devrait devenir la nouvelle tête d’affiche du projet, accompagné des jeunes Attila « bibbaba » Eötvös et reyyn. Un trio mêlant expérience et jeunesse, avec deux joueurs de 16 ans particulièrement prometteurs.

Sur le banc, Alexandre « Extra » Paoli devrait conserver son poste d’entraîneur malgré l’intérêt de Gentle Mates. Il retrouverait ainsi M0nkey M00n, son ancien coéquipier avec lequel il avait remporté les Championnats du monde 2021-2022 sous les couleurs de BDS. Des retrouvailles qui pourraient marquer le début d’un nouveau chapitre ambitieux pour la KC, attendue dès décembre pour le RLCS Club Championship. Après les adieux à trois figures majeures de son histoire récente, le Blue Wall s’apprête à découvrir un tout nouveau visage.

title: How to get Point Blank Kills in Modern Warfare 4
content:
There are some weapon camo challenges throughout Call of Duty history that give players the most trouble. In Modern Warfare 4 , several of these camo challenges have returned, including getting Point Blank Kills. These types of kills have long been a thorn in the side of camo grinders, but there are ways to make getting Point Blanks much easier in multiplayer.

Below, we’ll go through how to get Point Blank Kills and the best ways to go about doing so in Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer.

For starters, a Point Blank Kill is earned when you eliminate an enemy that is in extremely close proximity to you. It doesn’t matter when you damage an enemy, but when you see the kill pop up in the killfeed, you need to be within a certain range of the enemy for it to count as a Point Blank.

The exact range for a Point Blank Kill in Modern Warfare 4 is currently unknown, but we do know that it’s much closer than you might expect. In most cases, you need to be within roughly two meters of an enemy when you kill them to earn a Point Blank. This goes for all weapon classes as well, so unlike Longshot Kills , you have to be roughly two meters away even if you’re using something like a light machine gun or sniper rifle.

Now that you understand what a Point Blank Kill is, what’s the most optimal way to go about earning them in multiplayer? Well, it slightly depends on the gun you’re using, as some weapons are naturally stronger at closer ranges.

However, for the most part, you’ll want to use mobility attachments on your loadout so you can get your gun up quicker, which helps out tremendously when killing enemies at close-range. You could also go for an entirely hip-fire build and just shoot from the hip when killing enemies up close. This works best for most weapons, but you can ADS with something like an SMG or assault rifle and have the same results.

title: RLCS : AcroniK prend sa retraite à seulement 21 ans
content:
Une page se tourne sur la scène européenne de Rocket League. Bruno Alexandre « AcroniK » dos Santos Lopes a officialisé sa retraite sportive à seulement 21 ans, dans un court message publié sur les réseaux sociaux. « Je sais que ce ne sont pas les meilleurs mots pour annoncer une retraite, mais honnêtement, je n’ai pas envie d’écrire un long texte pour dire que j’arrête. Merci à tous. On se retrouve pour le prochain chapitre ! » , a confié le Portugais, sans donner davantage de détails sur ses futurs projets.

C’est surtout sous les couleurs de Team Liquid qu’AcroniK s’est fait un nom, en accompagnant l’éclosion de deux jeunes prodiges : Tristan « Atow » Soyez et Oskar « Oski » Gozdowski. Recrutés en février 2022 alors qu’ils n’avaient que 14 ans, les deux joueurs ont rapidement formé avec lui l’un des trios les plus redoutables d’Europe. Ensemble, ils ont remporté deux tournois régionaux, participé à cinq LAN internationales et atteint le dernier carré des Worlds 2023. Une aventure qui reste aujourd’hui le sommet de la carrière du Portugais, considéré comme le joueur le plus accompli de son pays sur Rocket League.

Après la séparation du trio en 2023, AcroniK n’a jamais vraiment retrouvé les mêmes résultats. Il s’est néanmoins illustré chez Luna Galaxy, avec notamment une deuxième place lors d’un tournoi régional des RLCS 2024, après une courte défaite face à BDS (3-4). Plus récemment, il avait rejoint NOVO Esports pour la saison 2026, disputant plusieurs tournois régionaux avant de représenter le Portugal aux championnats continentaux FIFAe, où sa sélection a atteint le top 8.

title: Call of Duty Passes $40 Billion in Lifetime Revenue With Modern Warfare 4 Launch
content:
Only a few days following the launch of Modern Warfare 4, the Call of Duty franchise has surpassed a whopping $40 billion USD in lifetime revenue, marking an incredible milestone for one of the most successful gaming series of all time.

The news came from Xbox CEO Asha Sharma herself, who confirmed this in an X announcement on October 26, shortly after the release of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. In case you missed it, MW4 came out on October 23 for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

“One of the most celebrated Call of Duty games in its 24-year history, and now $40B in lifetime franchise revenue,” Sharma said in a statement. “An incredible milestone. Congrats to the Activision team. And to the players, thank you for being with us.”

One of the most celebrated Call of Duty games in its 24-year history, and now $40B in lifetime franchise revenue. An incredible milestone. Congrats to the Activision team. And to the players, thank you for being with us. pic.twitter.com/AlpXydEQIQ

The number goes on to prove just how far the series has grown, especially within the past few years. In 2020, Activision had confirmed that the lifetime sales for the franchise were hovering around the $27 billion mark. By 2022, it had passed $30 billion, with approximately 425 million units being sold. Data-based estimates in 2024 placed it at roughly $35 billion across game sales, microtransactions, and subscriptions.

This means that about $10 billion in revenue was added over the course of the past four years.

It means the brand is also putting itself on a prize that has nothing to do with winning matches.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II Is Among the Best-Selling Games of 2026, 14 Years After Launch
content:
Call of Duty: Black Ops II, a game that first launched in November 2012, is the sixth best-selling game of 2026 in the US so far. Circana’s year-to-date chart through September puts it ahead of Forza Horizon 6, Tomodachi Life and Pokemon Pokopia, almost entirely on the back of the PS4 and PS5 port that Activision released on July 9. Those new PlayStation versions sent a 14-year-old shooter to the top of the US monthly chart in July.

Here is where it sits, how it got there so fast and why it matters for Call of Duty.

These are Circana’s projected US best-sellers for January to September 2026, ranked by dollar sales across physical and full-game digital purchases. Mobile games and add-on content are not counted.

Marvel’s Wolverine, which topped September after launching mid-month, sits 11th for the year. We covered that launch and the PS5 hardware bump in our September Circana breakdown .

Because PlayStation owners could not buy it before July. Black Ops II originally came out on PS3, Xbox 360, PC and Wii U, and the PS3 version never ran on PS4 or PS5. Xbox players kept access through backward compatibility, and PC players through Steam. Anyone on a modern PlayStation was locked out for over a decade.

Activision fixed that on July 9 with surprise PS4 and PS5 releases of both Black Ops and Black Ops II. Treyarch and Iron Galaxy handled the ports. Each game includes the campaign, multiplayer and Zombies, while the original map packs are sold separately through a season pass. Launch pricing was $19.99 per game until August 6, after which the standard price became $39.99.

title: Fortnite Wins Australian Court Battle, Reclaims Spot on iOS
content:
Fortnite returns to iOS in Australia on October 22, 2026, after the Federal Court of Australia ruled against Apple in the Epic Games antitrust case. Justice Jonathan Beach found that Apple broke competition law by limiting app distribution and payment options. Epic announced the return on X, and Apple plans to appeal. The court also ordered Apple to open iOS to third-party app stores and alternative payments by March 1, 2027.

This article covers the return date, the court ruling, the March 2027 changes, and Apple’s response.

The return follows a ruling that Apple violated Australian competition law. The court found that Apple restricted how apps are distributed and how users pay inside them. It also ordered Apple to readmit Fortnite and other Epic apps once Epic sends a written request. Readmission stays subject to App Store rules that match the court’s orders.

Epic CEO Tim Sweeney reacted on X after the remedies were issued. He called the outcome a “huge victory for consumers and developers” and said Epic is studying the verdict. He added that more details will follow.

title: All Police Station locations in Modern Warfare 4 DMZ
content:
One of the trickier DMZ Orders to complete in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ is to find and loot a Police Station. While this sounds simple on the surface, Police Stations aren’t too common in Hajin, so you might spend more time looking for one instead of completing the mission.

Fortunately, we have a complete guide of where to find every single Police Station in MW4 DMZ , as well as what you need to do once you’re inside.

By our count, there are five total Police Stations on the Hajin map in DMZ. They’re also quite spread out, so it might take you a while to reach one if you happen to spawn in a farther corner of the map. However, none are in high-threat areas, so you shouldn’t have a hard time getting there regardless of where you spawn.

Here’s a look at where each Police Station is located in DMZ:

Regardless of which Police Station you decide to enter, all you have to do once inside is find three containers to loot, which can be done by entering a few of the rooms in the main building. You’ll also need to eliminate five AI soldiers within the station walls. This is also fairly easy, as each Police Station is often crawling with enemies, both inside and outside.

And with that, you should have completed this DMZ Order on Page 5 in MW4 DMZ. If you’re still on this page, you’ll also want to check out our guide on where to open a safe in DMZ .

title: How to find and open a Safe in Modern Warfare 4 DMZ
content:
Throughout your career in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ, you’ll continually get to complete DMZ Orders, which are specific tasks that earn you rewards the more you complete them. While some of the DMZ Orders are simple, others can be rather difficult, and one of the more challenging ones is to “Open a Safe.”

While this sounds trivial at first glance, you then realize that Safes aren’t too common to find on the Hajin map in DMZ. Luckily, though, we know of some dedicated spots for Safes that allow you to complete this DMZ Order with no problem at all.

For us, this specific DMZ Order was on Page 5, and it even says that you can find Safes in Compounds and Locked Spaces . Of course, that doesn’t help a lot, as you still need to go out and search for these locations and then locate the Safe itself.

While you might have some serious trouble trying to find a “Locked Space,” you shouldn’t have many problems locating a Compound. These are marked by a tent icon on your Tac-Map and are fairly common in Hajin, particularly out in the woodlands or the side roads in between the major points of interest on the map.

In order to open a Safe in a Compound, you need to enter it and then clear out 100% of the enemy AI from the area . This is tracked by a percentage meter that appears on the left side of your screen when you enter a Compound. There are usually around 10-12 enemies in each Compound, and when they’re all cleared out, your meter will read 100%.

From here, you need to find the Safe that the Compound has stashed. For the most part, the Safe is located at the top of the guard tower, which is found at most Compounds . Just climb the stairs to get to the top, and you’ll find the Safe sitting on the ground next to a desk. Interact with it, loot the contents, and you’ll get a mission completion for this DMZ Order.

title: How to get the Tactical Nuke killstreak in Modern Warfare 4
content:
The most iconic killstreak in the entire Call of Duty franchise is the Tactical Nuke, and it’s confirmed to be returning in Modern Warfare 4 . Not only was the Nuke seen in a recent MW4 trailer, but we’ve also seen gameplay of the streak in a real match.

So, naturally, this has caused players everywhere to wonder: how do you get the Nuke in Modern Warfare 4? We’ll break the killstreak down for you in the guide below.

It’s been fully confirmed that the Tactical Nuke is an earnable killstreak in Modern Warfare 4. We’ve already seen players earn the Nuke, and you call it in very similarly to other games in the Modern Warfare franchise.

The Tactical Nuke is earned when you go on a 30 killstreak in MW4. Only gun, equipment, and Field Upgrade kills count towards this streak, so you can’t factor in kills from other killstreaks. When you go on a 30 streak, you’ll get a notification that you can call in the Nuke, which immediately ends the current match and wins the game for your team . You’ll then see a unique animation play out, including your character throwing up their middle finger while being blown away by the Nuke explosion.

Just like in every other Modern Warfare game, the Tactical Nuke isn’t a killstreak that you equip as part of your three core streaks . It’s a streak that’s active for all players at all times, so whenever you go on a 30 killstreak, you’ll earn the ability to call in the Nuke.

So there you have it: the Tactical Nuke is a killstreak in Modern Warfare 4, and it’s only earned once you hit a 30 killstreak with your gun or equipment. You can’t cheese the Nuke using killstreak kills like you could in the original MW2, so it’s very rare that you’ll earn or see a Nuke called in during a match of MW4.

title: All Weapon Prestige Camos in Modern Warfare 4 & how to earn them
content:
There are several different forms of progression in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , and one of the newer grinds in multiplayer is earning Weapon Prestige Camos. This system was brought back to the franchise in Black Ops 7, and Modern Warfare 4 has kept it in multiplayer, but with some twists.

Weapon Prestige Camos can be earned across all 33 weapons in MW4, but there are only four of them in total to unlock. You unlock each camo the same way for all weapons, but, of course, you need to know the unlock method before you start the grind. Below, we’ll explain everything you need to know about earning Weapon Prestige Camos in MW4.

The four Weapon Prestige Camos in MW4 multiplayer are: Pyroclast, Pyroclast Terminus, Pyroclast Scatter, and Pyroclast Cascade. You won’t start the process of earning any of these camos until you reach Weapon Prestige 1 with a weapon. This is accomplished by getting to that weapon’s max level, which usually goes to around 65-70 for most primary weapons.

Once you reach the max level for a weapon, you can enter Weapon Prestige , which works the same way that Classic Prestige Mode works in MW4 . When you enter Weapon Prestige, you reset that weapon back to level one and re-lock any non-shared attachments for it. You keep all shared attachments, though. From this point, you can re-unlock all weapon levels, and when you reach max level again, you’ll start earning Weapon Prestige Master levels. There are then 250 total levels to max out Weapon Prestige Master .

You can only Prestige weapons a single time in MW4, but once you do, you can start unlocking Weapon Prestige Camos. Look below to find out what you need to do to unlock all four Weapon Prestige Camos in multiplayer:

Unlike in Black Ops 7, which has unique Weapon Prestige Camos for every single weapon, the four camos are the same for all weapons in Modern Warfare 4. So, just because you earn Pyroclast Cascade for the M4 doesn’t then mean you have it unlocked for the Patriot XMR. Every Weapon Prestige grind is separate, but the Weapon Prestige Camos are the same.

title: Best Permanent Unlocks to spend Tokens on in Modern Warfare 4
content:
Classic Prestige has returned in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and that means that Permanent Unlock Tokens are coming back as well. If you’re unfamiliar with how Prestige Mode works, it resets your level back to one, but you receive a Permanent Unlock Token that you can use on any class item in multiplayer in exchange.

This is a huge benefit, as it lets you permanently unlock an item so you never have to unlock it again during the entire Prestige grind in Modern Warfare 4 . However, with so many items to choose from, which unlock gives you the best bang for your buck?

Below, we’ll give you five distinct class items in MW4 multiplayer that are most worth spending a Permanent Unlock Token on after you Prestige. The item list is in order from 1-5.

First on the list has to be the Stim, which is a piece of Tactical Equipment that quickly heals you back to full health when applied. The Stim is unlocked at level 47 in MW4 multiplayer, making it one of the final items you’ll unlock every single Prestige.

While there are other solid pieces of Tactical Equipment you can use until that level, once you get used to the Stim, there’s really no going back. The ability to get back into the fight instantly after being injured, compared to waiting for several seconds to recoup health, is one of the most important benefits of any item in multiplayer. If you use a Permanent Unlock Token on the Stim, your Tactical slot is pretty much set in stone on all loadouts in multiplayer.

Next up, we have the Axion assault rifle, which is unlocked at level 52. The Axion is one of the best assault rifles in Modern Warfare 4, and having it available for only three levels every Prestige is ultimately a waste of its potential. This is arguably a top meta weapon in multiplayer, so you’ll want it permanently unlocked as soon as possible.

title: RLCS : stizzy quitte Vitality et se rapproche de NIP
content:
Le mercato européen continue de s’agiter sur Rocket League. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Ninjas in Pyjamas devrait conserver Cristian « crr » Raigal et recruter Gaspar « stizzy » Andres, dont le contrat avec Vitality est arrivé à son terme. Les deux Espagnols, considérés parmi les meilleurs représentants de leur pays, pourraient ainsi évoluer ensemble pour la première fois sur le circuit RLCS. Ils devaient initialement représenter l’Espagne lors de l’Esports Nations Cup, finalement reportée à novembre 2027.

Pour NIP, ce rapprochement marquerait le début d’une nouvelle aventure après la séparation avec son précédent trio, composé de crr, Oaly et Joreuz. Une équipe qui avait pourtant réalisé une saison 2026 solide, avec cinq qualifications en LAN internationales et une troisième place à l’Esports World Cup. Son parcours s’était néanmoins terminé sur une déception aux championnats du monde, avec une élimination dès la phase de groupes et une 13-16e place finale. Invitée au RLCS Club Championship 2027, l’organisation souhaite désormais reconstruire un effectif capable de rivaliser avec les meilleures formations européennes.

Si l’association entre crr et stizzy semble bien engagée, l’identité du troisième joueur reste encore incertaine. Joreuz était initialement pressenti pour compléter le trio, mais cette option aurait perdu du terrain ces derniers jours. Plusieurs jeunes talents sont désormais étudiés, notamment bibbaba, prozy et le Français Reyyn, spécialiste du duel en 1v1. Aucun accord n’a toutefois été annoncé pour ce dernier poste.

Le staff pourrait également accueillir un visage bien connu de la scène européenne. ViolentPanda serait en discussions avancées avec Ninjas in Pyjamas pour devenir le nouvel entraîneur de l’équipe. Libéré par Shopify Rebellion le 14 octobre, le Néerlandais connaît déjà stizzy pour l’avoir accompagné chez Dignitas lors des saisons 2024 et 2025, avec notamment une finale au Major de Raleigh. Les négociations se poursuivent, mais aucun contrat n’aurait encore été finalisé.

Après une saison encourageante chez Vitality, malgré une élimination dans le top 12 des Worlds 2026, stizzy pourrait donc rebondir rapidement aux côtés de son compatriote crr. NIP espère finaliser son nouvel effectif avant le coup d’envoi du RLCS Club Championship, prévu en décembre à Londres. Dans un mercato européen particulièrement mouvementé, le duo espagnol pourrait constituer l’une des associations à suivre en 2027.

title: RLCS : NRG se sépare de ses champions du monde (off.)
content:
Une page majeure de l’histoire de Rocket League vient de se tourner. NRG a officiellement annoncé le départ de l’intégralité de son effectif champion du monde 2025, composé de Daniel, BeastMode et Atomic, ainsi que de son entraîneur Satthew. Une séparation particulièrement symbolique pour une équipe qui s’était imposée comme l’une des références de la scène nord-américaine au cours des trois dernières années.

L’aventure avait débuté chez G2 Esports, avec les arrivées de Daniel et BeastMode en provenance de Version1. Aux côtés d’Atomic, les deux joueurs avaient rapidement trouvé leurs marques, remportant notamment le deuxième Major de la saison 2024 avant d’atteindre la finale des championnats du monde. Passé sous les couleurs de NRG en 2025, le trio avait finalement décroché le titre mondial en battant Team Falcons en grande finale, après avoir également accumulé six victoires en Regional Opens. La saison 2026 s’est toutefois révélée moins brillante, avec une dernière apparition aux Worlds conclue dans le top 6.

Si les départs sont désormais officiels, les prochaines destinations des joueurs commencent également à se préciser. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Daniel et Atomic devraient poursuivre leur collaboration chez Shopify Rebellion, où ils retrouveraient Firstkiller. Satthew serait également attendu à la tête de ce nouveau projet, permettant à une partie du groupe champion du monde de rester réunie pour la saison 2027.

De son côté, BeastMode devrait rejoindre Gen.G Mobil1 Racing, aux côtés de Tawk et Chronic. Un changement particulièrement marquant puisqu’il s’agirait de sa première saison sans Daniel depuis avril 2023. Après trois années passées ensemble, les deux stars américaines pourraient donc désormais se retrouver adversaires sur le circuit RLCS.

Quant à NRG, l’organisation ne compte pas abandonner Rocket League. Invitée parmi les vingt structures fondatrices du RLCS Club Championship 2027, elle préparerait déjà un nouvel effectif autour de 2Piece, Wahvey et frosty, avec le Français adam_baguette au poste d’entraîneur. Des discussions avancées qui restent néanmoins à officialiser.
